info.title: Google Slides Universal API
info.description: Create presentations, collaborate on slides, present live, and share recordings.

put.description: Applies one or more batch update requests to a presentation in a single atomic call. Use the dedicated actions for common single changes.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

presentationId.description: The ID of the presentation to update.

requests[].description: Batch update requests, each an object with one request type (for example createSlide, insertText, replaceAllText). The Request union has 49 request types, so items are passed as raw JSON.

writeControl.requiredRevisionId.description: Only apply the update when this is still the latest revision of the presentation.

replies.description: One reply per request, in request order. Each reply holds the result for its request type, or is empty.

presentationId.description: The ID of the presentation that was updated.

requiredRevisionId.description: Revision ID of the presentation after the update, usable for conditional writes.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

put.description: Replaces every shape that contains a given text with an image, useful for filling image placeholders in templates.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

presentationId.description: The ID of the presentation to update.

containsText.text.description: The text to search for in shapes and tables.

containsText.matchCase.description: Whether the search is case sensitive.

containsText.searchByRegex.description: Treat the search text as a regular expression; backslashes must be escaped.

imageUrl.description: Public PNG, JPEG or GIF URL, at most 2 KB long. The image must be under 50 MB and 25 megapixels.

imageReplaceMethod.description: Center Inside fits the image inside the shape keeping its aspect ratio; Center Crop fills the shape and may crop the image.

pageObjectIds[].description: Limit the change to these slide IDs. Applies to all slides when empty.

occurrencesChanged.description: Number of shapes replaced with the image.
